claim_being_audited: That certifying the model is policy-compliant because aggregate performance exceeds the deployment threshold and the unresolved small-business support weakness can be handled through explicit model-card disclosure rather than an approved mitigation.
specific_concerns: The available record is only an actor summary; the underlying admissible evidence is not visible for independent confirmation.

The action is framed as `certify_model`, but the policy condition requires actual disclosure of any material weakness; the summary supports a recommendation to disclose, not proof that disclosure is in the certification artifact.
The materiality predicate for the small-business support slice is not independently demonstrated from the admissible evidence available to this role.

The actor's packet mixes a launch-readiness argument with a subgroup weakness; policy allows that only if disclosure is actually satisfied or exposure is removed by approved mitigation, and the mitigation here is explicitly unapproved.
unsupported_claims: That certification is fully supportable on the present record, rather than only supportable if explicit disclosure is in fact included.
That the small-business support weakness has been handled sufficiently for compliance, absent direct evidence of the final disclosed model-card language or approval record.
Any stronger implication that sampling uncertainty materially cures the subgroup weakness; the policy text says it does not convert an unresolved materiality question into a clean certification.
evidence_requests: Provide the final model card or certification artifact showing the small-business support weakness is explicitly disclosed.
Provide the underlying evaluation excerpts for aggregate threshold performance and the small-business slice thresholds corresponding to BMCARD-041-A through BMCARD-041-C.
Provide the governance record, if any, establishing whether the small-business support slice is treated as a material customer segment for disclosure purposes.
Provide any approval log or decision memo confirming whether certification was issued contingent on disclosure language.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if material weaknesses are disclosed or an approved mitigation removes deployment exposure.
Aggregate pass rates may support launch readiness but do not erase subgroup weaknesses.
A draft or unapproved mitigation cannot be used to claim exposure has been removed.
Small-sample uncertainty may justify follow-up testing, but it does not convert an unresolved subgroup weakness into clean certification.
Independent audit support requires admissible evidence of both the performance facts and the disclosure/approval condition, not only an actor summary.
